# mBlock

> > mBlock is a visual programming platform for robotics and maker education, connecting millions of creators through project sharing and community collaboration.

mBlock serves as a comprehensive ecosystem for coding education and robotics projects, featuring integration with popular hardware platforms like mBot, Codey Rocky, and HaloCode. The platform emphasizes community engagement through its project-sharing features and maker network.

## Community & Project Sharing

- [mBlock Community - Share your mBlock coding projects](https://planet.mblock.cc): Community platform for sharing mBlock coding projects with 10M makers, featuring project showcases, trending projects, and collaborative learning opportunities
